status: prospective analysis of existing measurements; aggregate results already known
scope: 200 original short FLEURS files on M4 Pro; not timing repeats or repeated long composites
estimand: sum of word errors / sum of reference words, per language
resamplingUnit: normalized reference phrase cluster; retain all recordings for that phrase, same cluster draw for every engine
interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles, descriptive and unadjusted for multiple comparisons
validation: reproduce all published aggregate errors and WER before computing intervals
limitations: exploratory uncertainty analysis, no general product or speaker-population significance claim
cluster handles duplicate reference text but not unknown speaker dependence
fixed sample contains only 100 recordings per language
no new inference or candidate tuning
